description.value: The Green is a modern Korean-fusion breakfast and brunch restaurant on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, specializing in vibrant, plant-forward dishes like bibim tofu bowls, smoked duck with brown rice, and signature multigrain cloud-foam beverages. The cafe operates under a 'Eat Green, Stay Green' philosophy and also offers catering with individual lunch boxes and buffet-style options. Touring cyclists heading through Vancouver's east side will find a health-conscious, vegan-friendly stop with a distinctive Korean-Canadian menu.

address.value: 2261 E Hastings St, Vancouver, BC V5L 1V3

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (12 spaces, covered) at 55m. Total: 12 spaces.

No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, device charging) are mentioned in either the OSM tags or the Instagram content.
